hoaxes.title: Anthropic's draft IPO filing reveals Claude will hold a seat on the company's board
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The reported draft covers revenue, losses and compute deals. No AI model sits on the board.

hoaxes.title: Nintendo says Switch Sports Resort will count your real steps to unlock new Wuhu Island areas
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The game launched October 22 with 12 sports. No step-counting feature has been announced.

hoaxes.title: Apple will sell the iPhone Duo's hinge on its own as a $199 replacement accessory
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Apple's real Duo accessories are a $79 case and a $129 folio with a kickstand.

hoaxes.title: Netflix will let viewers vote live on how its new films end, starting next month
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Netflix has made interactive specials before, but no live voting on endings has been announced.
